thread:
Noah Kim: Postmortem follow-up for the billing spike. Short summary: delayed consumer commits + overlapping retries produced duplicate token attributions for a subset of invoices. Need fast remediation plan and owners.

Elena Ruiz: I'll take the canonical aggregation work + checksum column to ensure single-source totals. Target PR by 2026-05-02.

Priya Rao: I'll own customer credits and the invoice reissue workflow. Need dry-run CSV and a signed approval before posting credits.

Sam Holt: I'll build a small-batch backfill that writes append-only adjustment records with job_run_id and sha256(invoice_id+window) as adjustment_id. Will include dry-run and canary modes. ETA 2026-05-03.

BillingBot: NOTE: BILL-2501 created. 21 invoices flagged. Suggested steps: dry-run -> legal review -> canary -> bulk apply.

Elena Ruiz: Dry-run SQL I'll run (small window):
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, SUM(token_delta) AS delta_tokens
FROM usage_partition
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-05-01T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-05-01T04:00:00Z'
GROUP BY invoice_id, customer_id
HAVING ABS(SUM(token_delta)) > 600;
I'll upload CSV to BILL-2501.

Noah Kim: Owners & due dates (confirm): Elena Ruiz  canonicalization + checksum column  due 2026-05-02; Sam Holt  backfill + canary  due 2026-05-03; Priya Rao  credits + comms  due 2026-05-05. Update BILL-2501 with PR links and completion times.

Priya Rao: ACK. I'll prepare email template and approval checklist for Legal.

Sam Holt: Will add leader-election (k8s lease) and idempotent writes. Dry-run CSV will be uploaded to /private/drive/BILL-2501/dryrun_2489002222.csv.

Noah Kim: Two process notes: 1) backfill must not mutate raw usage rows; only append adjustments; 2) run canary on top-5 highest-spend invoices and wait 24h before bulk. Sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to sign off. If blockers, ping @Noah. :white_check_mark:
